description: Send documents for e-signature with Zoho Sign, track request status, mint embedded signing links, list requests and recall (cancel) them. Document upload + request creation for served apps go through the platform's /api/zoho-sign proxy (it renders to PDF, uploads and auto-places signature fields server-side); these generic actions cover status, listing and recall.

configSchema.label: Client ID
configSchema.helpText: Client ID do Self Client criado em api-console.zoho.com (separador Client Secret).

configSchema.label: Client Secret
configSchema.helpText: Client Secret do Self Client em api-console.zoho.com.

configSchema.label: Grant Code
configSchema.helpText: Codigo unico do separador 'Generate Code' do Self Client, com os scopes ZohoSign.documents.ALL,ZohoSign.account.READ. Expira em minutos - guarde e corra o test_connection de imediato. Deixe vazio se colar um Refresh Token.

configSchema.label: Refresh Token
configSchema.helpText: Alternativa opcional ao Grant Code: um refresh token ja trocado por si (POST {accounts}/oauth/v2/token com grant_type=authorization_code). Nao expira.

configSchema.label: Data Center
configSchema.helpText: Data center Zoho da sua conta: com (US), eu, in, jp, au, ca ou sa. Leia-o no URL do Zoho Sign (sign.zoho.com -> com, sign.zoho.eu -> eu).

actions.description: Verify the credentials by listing signature requests (also exchanges a freshly pasted grant code for the permanent refresh token — run this right after saving).
List the signature requests visible to the connected Zoho Sign user.

Get a single signature request's metadata and current status (request_status: draft, inprogress, completed, declined, recalled, expired; per-recipient actions[].action_status: NOACTION, UNOPENED, VIEWED, SIGNED).

request_id.description: Zoho Sign request id (returned when the request was created).

actions.description: Recall (cancel) an in-progress signature request. Recipients can no longer sign it.
